"};

const GAME_QUESTIONS = [{"question": "من مؤسس مدينة الدرعية عام 850هـ؟", "options": ["أ. الإمام محمد بن سعود", "ب. الأمير مانع بن ربيعة المريدي", "ج. الإمام تركي بن عبدالله"], "answer": 1, "feedback": "تأسست الدرعية على يد الأمير مانع بن ربيعة المريدي."}, {"question": "في أي عام هجري تأسست مدينة الدرعية؟", "options": ["أ. 850هـ", "ب. 1139هـ", "ج. 1319هـ"], "answer": 0, "feedback": "يذكر العرض أن الدرعية تأسست عام 850هـ الموافق 1446م."}, {"question": "ما الموضعان اللذان تكوّنت منهما الدرعية في بدايتها؟", "options": ["أ. حجر اليمامة والعارض", "ب. الرياض والعيينة", "ج. غصيبة والمليبيد"], "answer": 2, "feedback": "تكوّنت الدرعية في الأساس من غصيبة والمليبيد."}, {"question": "ما العامل الجغرافي الذي ساعد على النشاط الزراعي في الدرعية؟", "options": ["أ. قربها من ساحل البحر الأحمر", "ب. موقعها على وادي حنيفة الخصب", "ج. وقوعها بعيدًا عن الأودية"], "answer": 1, "feedback": "ساعد موقع الدرعية على وادي حنيفة الخصب على ممارسة الزراعة."}, {"question": "إلى ماذا تطورت بلدة الدرعية وفق المخطط التاريخي في الدرس؟", "options": ["أ. إمارة ذات نفوذ", "ب. ميناء بحري", "ج. مدينة صناعية"], "answer": 0, "feedback": "يوضح مخطط الدرس تطور الدرعية إلى إمارة ذات نفوذ."}];
function createGameState(){return {current:0,done:[false,false,false,false,false],choices:[null,null,null,null,null],attempts:[0,0,0,0,0],firing:false,result:"",flight:null,intro:{phase:"idle",playing:false,offset:0}}}

let audio=null,editing=null,menuReturn=null;
function audioReady(){if(!audio){const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(C)audio=new C()}if(audio&&audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume().catch(()=>{});prepareOriginalAudio()}
function tone(f,at,duration,type='sine',volume=.05,end=f){if(!audio)return;const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,at);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30,end),at+duration);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,at);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume,at+.012);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,at+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(at);o.stop(at+duration+.015)}
function noise(at,duration,volume,low){const b=audio.createBuffer(1,Math.ceil(audio.sampleRate*duration),audio.sampleRate),data=b.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++)data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1);const src=audio.createBufferSource(),g=audio.createGain(),f=audio.createBiquadFilter();src.buffer=b;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.setValueAtTime(low,at);f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(90,at+duration);g.gain.setValueAtTime(volume,at);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,at+duration);src.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);src.start(at);src.stop(at+duration)}
function sound(type){if(!state.sound)return;audioReady();if(!audio)return;const t=audio.currentTime+.02;const sounds={slide:()=>{tone(330,t,.13,'sine',.035,440)},card:()=>{tone(620,t,.13,'sine',.04,820)},reveal:()=>{tone(440,t,.15);tone(660,t+.08,.18)},activity:()=>{tone(390,t,.12);tone(585,t+.09,.2)},start:()=>{[330,440,660].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,t+i*.12,.18,'triangle',.045))},launch:()=>{noise(t,.42,.07,3000);tone(140,t,.4,'sawtooth',.015,650)},blast:()=>{noise(t,.5,.12,1400);tone(70,t,.38,'sine',.065,35)},retry:()=>{tone(360,t,.16,'sine',.035,270);tone(270,t+.12,.18,'sine',.03)},win:()=>{[523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,t+i*.14,.3,'triangle',.04))}};if((type==='launch'&&playOriginal('launch'))||(type==='blast'&&playOriginal('impact'))||(type==='retry'&&playOriginal('impact',.28))||(type==='win'&&playOriginal('engine')))return;if(sounds[type])sounds[type]()}
function update(){const i=state.index,n=state.steps[i];slides.forEach((s,k)=>{s.hidden=k!==i;s.classList.toggle('active',k===i)});const current=slides[i];$$('[data-step]',current).forEach(el=>{const visible=Number(el.dataset.step)<=n;el.classList.toggle('shown',visible);if(el.classList.contains('reveal'))el.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!visible&&!el.classList.contains('closed')))});current.classList.toggle('modern',i===15&&n>=2);$('#prev').disabled=state.game.firing||(i===0&&n===0);$('#next').disabled=state.game.firing||(i===15&&n===stages[i])||(i===13&&n===1&&!state.game.done[state.game.current])||(i===13&&n===0&&state.game.intro.playing);$('#menuButton').disabled=state.game.firing;$('#counter').textContent=arabic(i+1)+' / '+arabic(slides.length);$('#stepCounter').textContent=arabic(n)+' / '+arabic(stages[i]);const pct=100*(i+(n/(stages[i]||1)))/slides.length;$('#progressFill').style.width=pct+'%';$('#progress').setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(Math.round(pct)));$$('#stationList button').forEach((b,k)=>{b.classList.toggle('current',k===i);if(k===i)b.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else b.removeAttribute('aria-current')});if(i===12)renderPrinces();if(i===13)renderGame()}
function stepTo(n,type='reveal'){if(state.game.firing)return;const i=state.index,old=state.steps[i];state.steps[i]=Math.max(0,Math.min(stages[i],n));update();if(old!==state.steps[i])sound(type);const el=$$('[data-step]',slides[i]).find(x=>Number(x.dataset.step)===state.steps[i]&&x.classList.contains('reveal'));if(el){const sc=el.closest('.scroll');if(sc&&sc.scrollHeight>sc.clientHeight){const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=sc.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom>sr.bottom||r.top<sr.top)sc.scrollTop+=r.top-sr.top-8}}}
function go(i,back=false){if(state.game.firing)return;if(state.index===13){pauseIntroduction();stopOriginalAudio()}const old=slides[state.index];$$('video',old).forEach(v=>v.pause());state.index=Math.max(0,Math.min(slides.length-1,i));if(back)state.steps[state.index]=state.index===13?(state.game.done.every(Boolean)?2:Math.min(state.steps[13],1)):stages[state.index];update();sound('slide')}
function next(){if(state.game.firing)return;const i=state.index,n=state.steps[i];if(i===13){if(n===0){if(state.game.intro.phase==='ready')enterTargets();else startIntroduction();return}if(n===1){if(state.game.done[state.game.current])advanceTarget();return}}if(n<stages[i])stepTo(n+1,i===1||i===4||i===9||i===12?'card':'reveal');else if(i<slides.length-1)go(i+1)}
function prev(){if(state.game.firing)return;const i=state.index;if(state.steps[i]>0)stepTo(state.steps[i]-1,'slide');else if(i>0)go(i-1,true)}
$('#next').addEventListener('click',next);$('#prev').addEventListener('click',prev);
slides.forEach(s=>s.addEventListener('click',e=>{const reveal=e.target.closest('[data-reveal]');if(reveal){const target=Number(reveal.dataset.step),current=state.steps[state.index];if(target>current)stepTo(current+1,'card');return}const set=e.target.closest('[data-set-step]');if(set){stepTo(Number(set.dataset.setStep));return}if(e.target.closest('button,textarea,video,[role="button"],.scroll,.edit-cell'))return;if(state.steps[state.index]<stages[state.index]&&state.index!==13)next()}));
$$('.sector').forEach(el=>{function choose(){const n=Number(el.dataset.question);state.selectedQuestion=n;$('#discussion').textContent=questions[n];$$('.sector').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('selected',x===el));el.style.transformOrigin='250px 250px';el.animate&&el.animate([{transform:'scale(1)'},{transform:'scale(1.025)'},{transform:'scale(1)'}],{duration:300});sound('activity')}el.addEventListener('click',choose);el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();choose()}})});

function renderPrinces(){const n=state.steps[12],count=Math.max(0,Math.min(8,n-12));if(state.princeStage!==n){state.princeCard=Math.max(0,count-1);state.princeStage=n}state.princeCard=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(0,count-1),state.princeCard));const selected=$$('[data-info]')[state.princeCard];$$('[data-info]').forEach((b,i)=>{b.hidden=count===0||i!==state.princeCard;b.classList.toggle('selected',i===state.princeCard)});$$('[data-info-tab]').forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=i>=count;b.classList.toggle('selected',count>0&&i===state.princeCard);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(count>0&&i===state.princeCard))});$('#infoPrev').disabled=count===0||state.princeCard===0;$('#infoNext').disabled=count===0||state.princeCard>=count-1;if(count>0&&selected){const associated=Number(selected.dataset.forPrince);state.selectedPrince=associated;$$('[data-prince]').forEach((b,i)=>{b.classList.toggle('selected',i===associated);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===associated))})}}

$$('[data-prince]').forEach((b,i)=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const info=princeMapping[i],count=Math.max(0,state.steps[12]-12);if(info>=0&&info<count){selectInfo(info)}else{state.selectedPrince=i;$$('[data-prince]').forEach((x,k)=>{x.classList.toggle('selected',k===i);x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(k===i))});sound('activity')}}));
$$('[data-info-tab]').forEach((b,i)=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>selectInfo(i)));$('#infoPrev').addEventListener('click',()=>selectInfo(state.princeCard-1));$('#infoNext').addEventListener('click',()=>selectInfo(state.princeCard+1));
$('#editor').addEventListener('close',()=>{if($('#editor').returnValue==='save'&&editing)editing.textContent=$('#editText').value;if(editing)editing.focus();editing=null});$('#clearCell').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#editText').value='';$('#editText').focus()});$('#resetTimeline').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.steps[12]=0;state.selectedPrince=null;state.princeStage=-1;state.princeCard=0;$$('[data-prince]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.remove('selected');b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')});update();sound('activity')});
function videoSetup(){$$('[data-video]').forEach(frame=>{const key=frame.dataset.video;const art=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');art.classList.add('video-scene');art.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');const use=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','use');use.setAttribute('href','#town');art.appendChild(use);frame.appendChild(art);const video=document.createElement('video');video.controls=true;video.playsInline=true;video.setAttribute('playsinline','');video.preload='metadata';video.setAttribute('aria-label','مشغل الفيديو '+arabic(Number(key.slice(-1))));if(VIDEO_URLS[key]){video.src=VIDEO_URLS[key];frame.appendChild(video);art.hidden=true}else{video.hidden=true;frame.appendChild(video);const placeholder=document.createElement('div');placeholder.className='video-placeholder';placeholder.innerHTML='<span class="play-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 3 16 9-16 9Z"/></svg></span><span>سيُضاف الفيديو هنا لاحقًا</span>';frame.appendChild(placeholder)}})}videoSetup();
slides.forEach((s,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.innerHTML='<span>'+arabic(i+1)+'</span><span></span>';b.lastElementChild.textContent=s.dataset.name;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{closeMenu();go(i)});$('#stationList').appendChild(b)});

$('#sound').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.sound=!state.sound;if(!state.sound)stopOriginalAudio();$('#sound').textContent=state.sound?'المؤثرات: تعمل':'المؤثرات: مغلقة';$('#sound').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(state.sound));if(state.sound){audioReady();sound('card')}});
$('#present').addEventListener('click',async()=>{state.present=!state.present;$('#app').classList.toggle('presentation',state.present);$('#present').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(state.present));$('#present').textContent=state.present?'إنهاء العرض':'وضع العرض';try{if(state.present&&document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();else if(!state.present&&document.fullscreenElement&&document.exitFullscreen)await document.exitFullscreen()}catch(e){/* واجهة العرض الأفقية تبقى متاحة على Safari. */}});

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.matches('textarea,input')||$('#editor').open)return;if(e.key==='Escape'){closeMenu();return}if(!$('#stationMenu').hidden){if(e.key==='Tab'){const list=$$('button',$('#stationMenu')),first=list[0],last=list[list.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus()}}return}if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='PageDown'){e.preventDefault();next()}else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='PageUp'){e.preventDefault();prev()}});
const sky=$('#sky');
const targetNames=['الهدف الأول','الهدف الثاني','الهدف الثالث','الهدف الرابع','الهدف الخامس'];

function renderGame(){const g=state.game,n=state.steps[13],intro=g.intro;$('#gameIntro').hidden=n!==0;$('#gameStart').hidden=n!==0||intro.phase==='video';$('#introVideoPanel').hidden=n!==0||intro.phase!=='video';$('#introText').hidden=intro.phase==='idle'||intro.phase==='video';$('#introText').classList.toggle('intro-enter',intro.phase==='audio'||intro.phase==='ready');$('#startGame').hidden=intro.playing||intro.phase==='ready';$('#startGame').textContent=intro.phase==='idle'?'ابدئي feedback=document.createElement('p');feedback.className='feedback';feedback.textContent=GAME_QUESTIONS[g.current].feedback;$('#gameStatus').appendChild(feedback)}}}
function enterTargets(){if(state.game.firing)return;if(state.game.intro.phase!=='ready'&&!state.introSeen)return;pauseIntroduction();state.game.intro.phase='ready';state.steps[13]=state.game.done.every(Boolean)?2:1;update();sound('activity')}
function advanceTarget(){const g=state.game;if(g.firing||!g.done[g.current])return;if(g.current<4){g.current++;g.result='';update();sound('activity')}else{state.steps[13]=2;update();sound('win')}}
function chooseAnswer(index){const g=state.game;if(g.firing||g.done[g.current]||state.steps[13]!==1)return;if(g.result==='retry'&&g.choices[g.current]===index)return;g.choices[g.current]=index;g.attempts[g.current]++;if(index===GAME_QUESTIONS[g.current].answer){sound('reveal');intercept()}else{g.result='retry';renderGame();stopOriginalAudio();sound('retry')}}
function intercept(){const g=state.game;if(g.firing||g.done[g.current])return;g.firing=true;g.result='';sky.classList.add('firing');const rocket=$('#rocket'),plume=$('#launchPlume'),target=$$('.plane')[g.current];rocket.hidden=false;plume.hidden=false;update();sound('launch');const started=performance.now(),duration=1400;let previousPoint=null,previousTrailTime=0;
function flight(now){const sr=sky.getBoundingClientRect(),tr=target.getBoundingClientRect(),lr=$('#launcher').getBoundingClientRect();const sx=lr.left-sr.left+lr.width*.5,sy=Math.min(sr.height-18,lr.top-sr.top+lr.height*.5),tx=tr.left-sr.left+tr.width*.5,ty=tr.top-sr.top+tr.height*.5;const progress=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(now-started)/duration)),p=progress*progress*(3-2*progress),cx=Math.max(18,Math.min(sr.width-18,sx+(tx-sx)*.25)),cy=Math.max(18,Math.min(sy,ty)-sr.height*.16);const x=(1-p)*(1-p)*sx+2*(1-p)*p*cx+p*p*tx,y=(1-p)*(1-p)*sy+2*(1-p)*p*cy+p*p*ty,dx=2*(1-p)*(cx-sx)+2*p*(tx-cx),dy=2*(1-p)*(cy-sy)+2*p*(ty-cy);rocket.style.left=x+'px';rocket.style.top=y+'px';rocket.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) rotate('+(Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI+90)+'deg)';
if(now-previousTrailTime>65){if(previousPoint&&previousPoint.w===sr.width&&previousPoint.h===sr.height){const a=previousPoint,b={x,y},length=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);if(length>1){const trail=document.createElement('div');trail.className='missile-trail';trail.style.left=a.x+'px';trail.style.top=a.y+'px';trail.style.width=length+'px';trail.style.transform='rotate('+(Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x)*180/Math.PI)+'deg)';sky.appendChild(trail);setTimeout(()=>trail.remove(),430)}}previousPoint={x,y,w:sr.width,h:sr.height};previousTrailTime=now}
if(progress>.2)plume.hidden=true;
if(progress<1){g.flight=requestAnimationFrame(flight)}else{rocket.hidden=true;plume.hidden=true;g.flight=null;const blast=document.createElement('div');blast.className='blast';blast.style.left=tx+'px';blast.style.top=ty+'px';blast.dataset.hitPlane=String(g.current);const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ASSETS.explosion;img.alt='';blast.appendChild(img);sky.appendChild(blast);sound('blast');g.done[g.current]=true;g.result='success';update();setTimeout(()=>{blast.remove();g.firing=false;sky.classList.remove('firing');update();$('#nextTarget').focus()},900)}}g.flight=requestAnimationFrame(flight)}
$('#startGame').addEventListener('click',()=>startIntroduction());$('#replayIntro').addEventListener('click',()=>startIntroduction(true));$('#enterTargets').addEventListener('click',enterTargets);$('#skipIntro').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.introSeen){pauseIntroduction();state.game.intro.phase='ready';enterTargets()}});$('#introMute').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.introMuted=!state.introMuted;$('#introVideo').muted=state.introMuted;if(introGain&&audio)introGain.gain.setValueAtTime(state.introMuted?.0001:.12,audio.currentTime);renderGame()});
$$('[data-choice]').forEach((b,i)=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>chooseAnswer(i)));$('#nextTarget').addEventListener('click',advanceTarget);$('#restartGame').addEventListener('click',()=>{pauseIntroduction();stopOriginalAudio();state.game=createGameState();$('#introVideo').currentTime=0;state.steps[13]=0;update();sound('activity')});$('#toAssessment').addEventListener('click',()=>go(14));
for(let i=0;i<24;i++){const c=document.createElement('i');c.className='confetti';c.style.left=(i*4.3)+'%';c.style.animationDelay=(i%8)*.25+'s';c.style.background=['#CBA566','#226349','#d78438','#74a7b8'][i%4];$('#gameFinish').appendChild(c)}
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{$$('.blast').forEach(blast=>{const plane=$$('.plane')[Number(blast.dataset.hitPlane)];if(plane){const sr=sky.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=plane.getBoundingClientRect();blast.style.left=(pr.left-sr.left+pr.width*.5)+'px';blast.style.top=(pr.top-sr.top+pr.height*.5)+'px'}})});

const originalBuffers={},originalSources=new Set(),originalDecodes={};let originalAudioLoading=false;
function prepareOriginalAudio(){if(!audio||!audio.decodeAudioData||originalAudioLoading)return;originalAudioLoading=true;Object.entries(EMBEDDED_SOUNDS).forEach(([key,encoded])=>{originalDecodes[key]=new Promise(resolve=>{try{const raw=atob(encoded),bytes=new Uint8Array(raw.length);for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)bytes[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);audio.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer,buffer=>{originalBuffers[key]=buffer;resolve(buffer)},()=>resolve(null))}catch(e){resolve(null)}})})}
function playOriginal(key,limit){if(!audio||!state.sound||!originalBuffers[key])return false;originalSources.forEach(old=>{if(old.soundKey===key){try{old.stop()}catch(e){}originalSources.delete(old)}});try{const source=audio.createBufferSource(),gain=audio.createGain(),t=audio.currentTime,duration=Math.min(originalBuffers[key].duration,limit||originalBuffers[key].duration);source.buffer=originalBuffers[key];source.soundKey=key;const volume=key==='engine'?.07:.12;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume,t+.025);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume,t+Math.max(.03,duration-.12));gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+duration);source.connect(gain);gain.connect(audio.destination);originalSources.add(source);source.onended=()=>originalSources.delete(source);source.start(t);source.stop(t+duration);return true}catch(e){return false}}
function stopOriginalAudio(){originalSources.forEach(source=>{try{source.stop()}catch(e){}});originalSources.clear()}
let introSource=null,introGain=null,introStartedAt=0,introToken=0;
function pauseIntroduction(){const intro=state.game.intro;if(intro.phase==='video')$('#introVideo').pause();if(introSource){if(audio)intro.offset=Math.min(originalBuffers.engine?originalBuffers.engine.duration:20.256,intro.offset+Math.max(0,audio.currentTime-introStartedAt));introSource.onended=null;try{introSource.stop()}catch(e){}introSource=null;introGain=null}introToken++;intro.playing=false}
function completeIntroduction(){state.game.intro.phase='ready';state.game.intro.playing=false;state.game.intro.offset=0;state.introSeen=true;introSource=null;introGain=null;update()}
async function beginIntroAudio(){const intro=state.game.intro,token=++introToken;intro.phase='audio';intro.playing=true;update();audioReady();let buffer=originalBuffers.engine;if(!buffer&&originalDecodes.engine)buffer=await originalDecodes.engine;if(token!==introToken||state.index!==13||state.steps[13]!==0)return;if(!buffer||!audio){intro.playing=false;update();return}const offset=Math.min(intro.offset,buffer.duration);if(offset>=buffer.duration-.01){completeIntroduction();return}try{introSource=audio.createBufferSource();introGain=audio.createGain();introSource.buffer=buffer;introGain.gain.setValueAtTime(state.introMuted?.0001:.12,audio.currentTime);introSource.connect(introGain);introGain.connect(audio.destination);introStartedAt=audio.currentTime;introSource.onended=()=>{if(token===introToken)completeIntroduction()};introSource.start(0,offset)}catch(e){intro.playing=false;introSource=null;update()}}
function startIntroduction(replay=false){if(state.game.firing||state.index!==13||state.steps[13]!==0)return;const intro=state.game.intro;if(intro.playing&&!replay)return;audioReady();if(replay){pauseIntroduction();$('#introVideo').currentTime=0;intro.phase='idle';intro.offset=0}if(intro.phase==='ready')return;if(intro.phase==='audio'){beginIntroAudio();return}intro.phase='video';intro.playing=true;const video=$('#introVideo');if(!video.getAttribute('src'))video.src=INTRO_VIDEO;video.muted=state.introMuted;video.volume=.45;update();const token=++introToken;const play=video.play();if(play&&play.catch)play.catch(()=>{if(token===introToken){intro.playing=false;update()}})}
$('#introVideo').addEventListener('ended',()=>{if(state.index===13&&state.steps[13]===0&&state.game.intro.phase==='video')beginIntroAudio()});$('#introVideo').addEventListener('pause',()=>{if(!$('#introVideo').ended&&state.game.intro.phase==='video'){state.game.intro.playing=false;if(state.index===13)update()}});$('#introVideo').addEventListener('play',()=>{if(state.game.intro.phase==='video'){state.game.intro.playing=true;if(state.index===13)update()}});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&state.index===13){pauseIntroduction();if(!state.game.firing)update()}});

update();
</script>
</body></html>
